# Qasem Portal

> Qasem Portal is a technology company registered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and founded by Adam Qasem in 2026. It builds and operates modern applications for hospitality and adjacent sectors. Its venture is Cue, a restaurant reservation and venue booking app from Amman, Jordan.

Facts, as this site states them:

- Name: Qasem Portal
- What it does: builds and operates modern applications for hospitality and adjacent sectors
- Registered in: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Founded: 2026
- Founder: Adam Qasem
- Venture: Cue, a restaurant reservation and venue booking app from Amman, Jordan, at https://www.cue-app.net (status: pre-launch)
- Language of this site: English
- Company profile: https://www.linkedin.com/company/qasem-portal

- [Home](https://www.qasem-portal.com/): what Qasem Portal is, what it sets out to do, and the company in brief
